about:
E & E Metal Fab Inc was founded in 2003 in Lebanon, Pennsylvania. The company is family-owned and operated, established by individuals with years of experience in the metal fabrication industry who decided to direct their own shop.

The shop provides metal fabrication services including precision plasma cutting, welding, bending, punching, rolling, sawing, and painting. It works with steel, stainless steel, and aluminum, and employs a team of fabricators with decades of industry experience, though specific headcount and facility size are not disclosed.

The company serves businesses in the Lebanon, PA area and surrounding region that require custom metal fabrication. Its customer base includes long-standing clients who have followed the company since its startup, as well as new customers across various industrial sectors, though specific industries are not listed.

The founders started the business because they believed they could deliver work more efficiently and at higher quality by running their own operation. The company emphasizes building lasting relationships with customers, treating them as part of the team, and has earned recognition such as the Governor's Impact Award finalist and the U.S. Chamber's Blue Ribbon Award.

about:
EDC Inc. was founded in 1981 in Kernersville, North Carolina, as a family-owned contract manufacturer of electronic assemblies. The company operates from a 40,000-square-foot facility in the state and has remained under family ownership for over four decades.

The shop provides a full range of electronic manufacturing services, including printed circuit board assembly (surface-mount, through-hole, and mixed-technology), box-build and panel assembly, wire harness and cable assembly for industrial, consumer, and MIL-SPEC applications, and custom overmolding and injection molding. Work is performed turnkey or from customer-supplied kits, spanning prototype runs through full-scale production.

EDC serves customers in industrial, consumer, and military/defense sectors, with wire harnesses built to MIL-SPEC requirements. Its client base includes original equipment manufacturers and other companies that consolidate multiple electronic assembly processes under one roof.

The company emphasizes its ability to handle all electronic manufacturing disciplines from a single location, reducing vendor count for clients. It cites a 40-year track record of on-time delivery, responsive communication, and a hassle-free experience as reasons customers stay for decades.

name: EGT Solar
old_description: EGT Solar is a DBA of EvenGreen Technology; our company, founded in 2010 with the mission to provide education and opportunities for Idahoans interested in Solar Energy. Started in a small office in Boise, EGT quickly became the most well-known source for alternative energy products and resources in the Treasure Valley.
about:
EGT Solar operates from Meridian, Idaho, where it moved in 2012 after launching in 2010 as EvenGreen Technology in a small Boise office. The company was founded by Bryan M. Lawley, who serves as president, with Rob Black as CEO/partner and Dan Bennett as general manager.

The firm installs residential and commercial photovoltaic systems, adds battery backup storage, and provides ongoing service and maintenance through a dedicated in-house team. Three full-time installation crews are led by master, journeyman, and apprentice electricians, supported by permitting, project processing, and sales staff. EGT Solar has completed over 100 commercial projects and ranks as Idaho’s top-volume residential contractor.

Customers include homeowners throughout the Treasure Valley and commercial clients such as consulting firms and national institutions — Daniel Aguilar’s background notes work for Bank of America, JPMorgan Chase, and Wells Fargo. The company also partners with lenders to offer zero-down financing.

EGT Solar was started to educate Idahoans about solar energy and keep energy dollars in the state. Its owners co-founded the Idaho Clean Energy Association and advocate for favorable net-metering policies, emphasizing an ethics-first approach over aggressive sales tactics.

The firm provides a full suite of solar and roofing services, including solar panel installation, repair, and removal; roof repair, replacement, and re-installation; and gutter, trim, and siding installation. Customers range from homeowners seeking to cut utility costs to business owners pursuing energy savings and property-value gains. The company cites installations at industrial, commercial, and residential sites throughout its four-state service area.

name: ESF Wholesale Furniture
old_description: ESF Wholesale Furniture is a U.S. importer and distributor of high-quality European-made home furnishings, specializing in Italian, Spanish, and Ukrainian lines. Since 1996, the B2B company has served North American retailers, designers, and dealers, offering both vast in-stock programs and custom special order options.
about:
ESF Wholesale Furniture operates from Staten Island, New York, and has been importing European-made home furnishings since 1996. The business was established to connect North American retailers with manufacturers in Italy, Spain, Poland, and Ukraine, building a catalog that spans living room, bedroom, dining, and wall-unit collections.

The company functions as a B2B importer and distributor rather than a manufacturer. It maintains a stock program for immediate fulfillment and a special-order program that draws directly from partner factories. Brands represented include Arredoclassic, Camelgroup, Fama, Franco, Di Oro Collezione, Status, Garcia Sabate, Tomasella, Trasman Kids, Dupen, MCS, Gala, New Trend Concepts, G&G Italia, Stella, Bizzarto, Nicoletti, Klaussner, Nacher, and Befame. A dedicated service team handles warranty claims, replacement parts — from small hardware to major panels — and after-sales support.

Primary customers are furniture retailers, interior designers, and project buyers across the United States and Canada. The company supplies both independent stores and larger dealer networks, offering marketing materials and dedicated account service to help partners sell the European lines.

ESF emphasizes that its European partners follow strict EU environmental and labor standards, using sustainable production practices that reduce waste and energy use. The firm also highlights its exclusive brand partnerships, such as the Di Oro Collezione collection developed in-house and produced in Italy, and the Moonap by Fama range engineered for compact packaging and simplified dropshipping.

about:
Eastern Scientific Inc. (ESI) was founded in 1978 in Baltimore, Maryland. The company began as a technology-focused representative firm, partnering with manufacturers to bring advanced equipment to market.

ESI does not manufacture products itself; instead, it represents a portfolio of manufacturers supplying capital equipment and components for semiconductor, solar, optical, and industrial vacuum applications. Its services include market introduction, technology commercialization, and technical support for equipment such as metrology tools, deposition systems, plasma generators, and etch systems. The firm has also assisted in launching four capital-equipment startups targeting hard-disk drives, optical filters, superconductor wire, and flexible solar panels.

The company serves research institutions including MIT, Harvard, Princeton, Dartmouth, and Johns Hopkins, as well as original equipment manufacturers such as KLA, Brooks Automation, Varian, and Tokyo Electron, and device makers like IBM, GlobalFoundries, Analog Devices, Cree, Intel, and Texas Instruments. Its coverage spans the semiconductor, solar, optical, and industrial vacuum sectors.

ESI states its mission is to provide leading-edge technology companies with the next generation of manufacturing equipment, remaining committed to meeting future demands through its network of manufacturer partnerships.
